item.text: The current code splits session creation into three paths. I found two concrete inconsistencies: an empty cluster name reaches the remote path, and local credentials can be rejected when kube_service discovery does not list that cluster. Endpoint dialing also mutates shared session fields while choosing a target.

item.text: The new reproduction fails as expected: a configured local credential is rejected as “not found,” and an empty remote cluster name reaches certificate handling and panics. I’m moving the cluster check ahead of path selection and using explicit endpoints for dialing.

item.text:
Updated [forwarder.go](/app/lib/kube/proxy/forwarder.go) so session creation returns `trace.NotFound` for a missing or unknown Kubernetes cluster, prefers configured local credentials, and uses the reverse tunnel for remote clusters. Session dialing now passes the selected endpoint’s address and server ID through `dialEndpoint` and records the address used. Added regression tests in [forwarder_test.go](/app/lib/kube/proxy/forwarder_test.go).

The full `lib/kube/proxy` test package and `git diff --check` pass.
